statement: One saga repository reports a persistence it never was, and the name it reports belongs to an integration this milestone removes.

site.whatItActuallyIs: The saga repository of the Azure Service Bus message session. It stores saga state in the session state of the broker and never used MongoDB.

rule: Every other saga repository names its own persistence. This one names a different product, so a probe reader is told the wrong store.

testCoverage.onlyPersistenceAssertionInTheSuite: SimpleConfiguration_Specs asserts "memory" for the in memory repository
testCoverage.consequence: No test pins the wrong value, so correcting it breaks nothing that exists.

whyThisIsNotJustAStaleReference: Removing MongoDB from the graph does not make this line right. It was already wrong before the removal; the removal only made it visible.
scopeOfAChange: Diagnostic probe output of one repository. No public signature, no message contract, no serialisation, no behaviour of the saga itself.
